faqs.q: Is this Coconut Oil edible for cooking as well as safe for baby massage?
faqs.a: Yes! Because it is 100% pure cold-pressed food-grade Extra Virgin Coconut Oil with 0 additives or perfumes, you can use the exact same jar for cooking, oil pulling, baby massage, and hair care.

faqs.q: Why did my Coconut Oil turn solid white in winter?
faqs.a: Pure unrefined coconut oil has a natural melting point of 24°C (76°F). In cool Kathmandu weather it solidifies into a soft white butter, and in warm weather it turns crystal-clear liquid. Place the jar in a bowl of warm water for 5 minutes if you prefer it liquid in winter.
